request_json.title: Alder Relay 1.8 operator quickstart
request_json.text: Alder Relay 1.8 operator quickstart. Scope: release 1.8 only. A request may be attempted at most three times in total: the initial attempt and at most two retries. Only a transport timeout is retryable. HTTP 4xx responses are final and must not be retried. This document is not a policy for later major policy revisions.
